purpose: Test one student-width increase while keeping the validated WIDE+QUERY action-conditioned predictor protocol, optimization budget, targets, seeds, and held-out ranking blocks fixed.

research_question.primary: Does changing only NativeDinoPrefixStudent hidden_dim from 128 to 256 materially improve held-out planner-candidate ranking at the same 1500-update WIDE+QUERY training budget?
research_question.secondary: Does the h256 student meet the existing predictor-level absolute replacement gates without losing logged-action latent fidelity, causality, or predictor-only speedup?
research_question.unit_of_analysis: one held-out context x one fresh action-prefix seed block; candidates within a block are repeated measurements, not independent replicates
research_question.primary_comparison: h256 WIDE-QUERY step1500 minus the read-only authoritative h128 WIDE-QUERY step1500 baseline

scope.teacher_targets: the same frozen teacher rollout contract used by the optimization-length baseline

parent_protocol.manifest_policy: Use the staged CPU-prepared query-coverage manifest supplied at run time; do not regenerate, reorder, subsample, or replace it.

treatment.initialization: Instantiate a fresh h256 NativeDinoPrefixStudent with the same constructor/RNG procedure and training seed as the baseline; do not copy, reshape, interpolate, or load the h128 state_dict.
treatment.anchor_input: cached native DINO observation latent z_t
treatment.action_input: five normalized action tokens, each packing five primitive actions
treatment.output: five future native observation latents z[t+1:t+5]

frozen_training_bank.heldout_exclusion: No held-out episode, context, observation, action, seed, or evaluation candidate may enter training.

one_step_cem_resample.scoring: frozen teacher terminal objective for the same training context
one_step_cem_resample.precompute: one deterministic CPU-generated bank before the first student update
one_step_cem_resample.bank_identity: same deterministic WIDE+QUERY bank contract, seeds, context order, call order, M, K, objective, and variance floor as the h128 baseline; no new mixture or resampling policy

frozen_training_bank.target_pairing: Every logged, Gaussian, and CEM-resampled prefix is passed through the same frozen teacher rollout to produce detached dense targets.

training.per_update: Use the frozen context schedule and frozen 16/8/8 role schedule, materialize the frozen WIDE+QUERY bank rows, run the frozen teacher rollout, compute dense native-latent MSE, and update the h256 student.

context_schedule_compatibility.purpose: Preserve the exact h128 baseline WIDE context-index schedule after the old 500-step NARROW RNG burn-in.

randomness_and_schedule.rng_policy: Generate context indices, role permutations, Gaussian proposals, CEM candidates/resamples, held-out candidates, and timing candidates on CPU with explicit generators before transfer to the selected GPU.
randomness_and_schedule.seed_policy: All seeds and call order are fixed before execution; no result-dependent seed replacement or additional tuning run is permitted.

ranking.block_definition: 8 held-out contexts x 2 fresh action-prefix seeds
ranking.candidate_distribution: independent Normal(0, 1) normalized primitive actions with the existing frozen predictor-level sampler
ranking.candidate_bank: Generate one shared CPU candidate bank; evaluate h256 and align it to the h128 baseline by exact (seed, context_index) block key.
ranking.paired_comparison: Within each aligned block, h256 and the read-only h128 baseline are compared against the same frozen teacher costs, candidate action tensor, context, and goal.

paired_metrics.aggregation: Compute the median of the 16 paired block deltas and count strict positive deltas; do not subtract arm-level medians.
paired_metrics.capacity_primary: median paired Spearman delta, median paired top-30 delta, and their positive-block counts

logged_action_fidelity.actions: each held-out context's real logged action prefix
logged_action_fidelity.statistic: mean across horizons and contexts of dense relative native-latent MSE

causality.procedure: For each prefix horizon k, change only action tokens after k while keeping z_t and the first k tokens fixed.
causality.metric: maximum absolute difference in output at horizon k

latency.boundary: cached native observation latent plus normalized action prefix through one h256 predictor forward or the five-step frozen teacher rollout
latency.h128_latency_ratio: median(h256_ms) / baseline h128 step1500 median_ms; diagnostic_only

heldout_evaluation.telemetry: During GPU execution, append utilization and VRAM samples every 30 seconds to the job artifact log.

capacity_effect.comparison: h256 step1500 - authoritative h128 WIDE-QUERY step1500

logged_fidelity_noninferiority.comparison: h256 / h128 teacher-relative MSE on all 8 held-out logged contexts

decision_levels.capacity_effect: PASS iff the four capacity_effect thresholds all pass; report independently of replacement readiness.
decision_levels.full_replacement: GO iff capacity_and_integrity, h256 absolute fidelity, logged-fidelity ratio, final causality, and predictor-only latency all pass.
decision_levels.non_equivalence: capacity_effect PASS does not imply full_replacement GO; full_replacement GO does not require capacity_effect PASS.
decision_levels.density_contrast_entry: Only if this cell is valid, full_replacement is NO-GO, and capacity_effect is FAIL; then freeze a separate coverage/density contrast while holding h256, 1500 steps, loss, seeds, held-out blocks, and latency boundary fixed.
decision_levels.density_contrast_stop: If capacity_effect PASS, do not enter data/query density contrast in this campaign; capacity remains the active explanation. If the cell is invalid, do not use it to select the next axis.

gates.overall_decision: Report capacity_effect and full_replacement separately. Do not retune after observing results.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_capacity_effect_pass: Under the frozen DINO-WM PushT predictor-level contract, increasing NativeDinoPrefixStudent width from 128 to 256 at the fixed WIDE+QUERY 1500-step budget materially improves paired held-out candidate ranking under the stated block-level thresholds.
claim_boundary.allowed_if_full_replacement_go: The h256 student meets the frozen predictor-level replacement gates against the teacher, including absolute ranking fidelity, logged-action latent-MSE non-inferiority, causality, and predictor-only latency.
claim_boundary.one_step_cem_qualification: The WIDE+QUERY bank remains a training-only M=64/K=8 one-step CEM elite-resample mixture; no claim about full multi-step goal-conditioned CEM integration is permitted.
forbidden: multi-step CEM integration or full-plan latency
causal claims beyond the frozen schedule and paired block comparison
parameter-count or h256/h128 latency ratios as success evidence

execution_constraints.checkpoint_return: No checkpoint retrieval is required as a primary result; any local snapshot is an audit artifact only.
